title: zhaoanthus proanthus
intro: Zhaoanthus proanthus, commonly known as the Chinese Foxglove, is a flowering plant native to China. It has been used in traditional Chinese medicine for centuries, valued for its health benefits, which include the ability to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and improve cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Zhaoanthus proanthus include its potential to inhibit the growth of cancer cells, reduce anxiety and stress, and improve sleep quality. The bioactive constituents of the plant include cardenolides, such as proscillaridin and digoxin, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
